Subject: Notice of PHAOA General Body Meeting (GBM) on 22nd Dec 2024

Dear Residents,
This is to inform you that the General Body Meeting (GBM) of Panchsheel Hynish
AOA has been scheduled as follows:
Date: 22nd Dec 2024
Time: 11:00 AM
Duration: 60 mins
Venue: Badminton Court

The meeting will cover the following agenda:
1. Current Progress Updates:  Updates on maintenance and infrastructure
2. NPCL multipoint: Status of Multipoint
3. MOU Compliance Status: Update on adherence to the Memorandum of
Understanding (MOU) with Panchsheel Buildtech and further action plan
4. Open House
We urge all residents to attend this meeting and actively participate in the
discussions to collectively decide the best course of action for the society's
welfare.
Thank you for your cooperation.

Regards,

Vijay Mohan Rastogi
